issues.t: Charging unit (ICCU) failure and loss of drive power (recall)
issues.sym: A loud pop from under the rear seat, warning lights and a message, then sudden loss of power or limp mode while driving. The car may stop charging, and the 12-volt battery can go flat.
issues.why: The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) charges both the 12-volt battery and, from a plug, the main battery. It can be damaged by excess current, and when it fails the 12-volt battery stops charging until the car loses drive power. Genesis recalled 2023-2025 GV60s to inspect it, replace the unit and fuse if needed, and update its software. Owners report failures even after the recall work.
issues.next: Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and get the recall done. If power drops while driving, turn on your hazard lights and get off the road. If it happens again after the recall, have it towed to a dealer and keep every repair order.

issues.t: 12-volt battery goes flat and the car won't wake up
issues.sym: The car is dead with blank screens, won't unlock or turn on, or gets stuck in Neutral and won't go into Park. You may need to open the hood and jump the small 12-volt battery.
issues.why: The small 12-volt battery runs the car's computers. If the ICCU stops charging it, or software doesn't top it up while the car sits, it runs down. Genesis issued a bulletin for low 12-volt charging from an ICCU fault (code P1A9096), and a software update that changes how the car keeps the 12-volt battery charged when parked.
issues.next: Keep a small jump pack in the car. Have a dealer test the 12-volt battery and ICCU, and make sure the ICCU recall and software updates are done.

issues.t: Car slows into limp mode while driving
issues.sym: The car suddenly limits its speed and power while you're driving, usually with a warning message.
issues.why: If the 12-volt battery voltage drops too low, the car's control unit puts it into limp-home mode to protect itself. Genesis issued a software update for 2023-2025 GV60, GV70 Electrified and G80 Electrified that changes how fast the car can go at each voltage level.
issues.next: Get to a safe spot with hazard lights on. Ask a dealer for the update in bulletin 24-01-091G and have the 12-volt battery and ICCU checked.

issues.t: Rear driveshafts can break (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or bang from the rear followed by a sudden loss of drive power.
issues.why: On some early 2023 GV60s the rear driveshafts may fracture. Genesis recalled them to replace both rear driveshafts.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. If you hear a bang and lose power, coast to a safe stop and have the car towed.

issues.t: Rear inner driveshaft may be weak and snap (recall)
issues.sym: A sudden loss of drive power, sometimes with a clunk from under the car, when accelerating.
issues.why: Some rear inner driveshafts were not heat-treated properly, so they can break under load. Genesis recalled a small number of 2023 GV60s for new shafts.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall even if the earlier driveshaft recall was done. Tow the car if it loses drive.

issues.t: Seat belt pretensioner can burst in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign. The danger is in a crash, when the front seat belt tightener fires.
issues.why: The front seat belt pretensioners can rupture when they fire and throw metal pieces into the cabin. Genesis recalled many models, including the 2023 GV60, to fit a cap over them.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free fix as soon as possible.

issues.t: Front passenger seat belt may not extend or latch (recall)
issues.sym: The front passenger seat belt locks up, won't pull out far enough, or can't be buckled.
issues.why: A locking part in the passenger seat belt retractor can be faulty. Genesis recalled some 2023 GV60s to inspect and replace the belt.
issues.next: Don't let anyone ride in that seat if the belt won't buckle. Check your VIN and get the free fix.

issues.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The driver's display goes dark, so you can't see your speed, charge level or warning lights.
issues.why: A software error can make the instrument display fail. Genesis recalled 2023-2025 GV60s for a free update, over the air or at a dealer.
issues.next: Check your VIN and install the update. If the display goes blank, pull over safely and restart the car.

issues.t: Windshield top trim can come off (recall)
issues.sym: The shiny trim strip along the top of the windshield lifts, flutters, whistles or comes off while driving.
issues.why: The stainless-steel molding at the top of the windshield may not stay attached and can fly off, which is a hazard to cars behind. Genesis recalled 2023-2025 GV60s to replace it.
issues.next: Check your VIN. If the trim is loose, don't drive at highway speed until the dealer replaces it.

issues.t: Backup camera can shut off in reverse (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture disappears from the screen while you're backing up.
issues.why: A software problem in the rearview camera system. Genesis recalled some 2024-2025 GV60s for a free update.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the update. Use your mirrors and look over your shoulder until it's done.

issues.t: Check engine light and charging stops at 80%
issues.sym: After charging, the check engine (malfunction) light comes on and the battery won't charge past 80%.
issues.why: The battery management software can misread one battery cell's voltage and set a false code (P1AA900). Genesis says nothing else is affected and released a software update.
issues.next: The car is OK to use, but ask a dealer for the battery software update in bulletin 24-01-070G.

issues.t: Limited-slip differential warning
issues.sym: A warning light or message with stored codes for the electronic limited-slip differential (P188213, P188900 or P189600).
issues.why: The electric actuator that controls the rear limited-slip differential can set fault codes. Genesis issued a bulletin telling dealers how to diagnose and repair it.
issues.next: Drive gently and have a dealer read the codes and follow bulletin 23-DS-003G.

issues.t: Horn stops working
issues.sym: Nothing happens, or only a weak sound, when you press the horn.
issues.why: Moisture or burned contacts inside the horn can stop it working. Genesis has a bulletin to test and replace the horns.
issues.next: Get it fixed soon since a working horn is a safety item. Ask the dealer about bulletin 25-GI-009G.

issues.t: Rattle from the tailgate
issues.sym: A rattle from the back of the car while driving, especially on rough roads.
issues.why: The tailgate can move against its side guide bumpers. Genesis fixes it by adding washers to the bumpers.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin 24-BD-010G.

issues.t: Fast-charge port missing pin covers
issues.sym: When you open the charge door, the two large DC fast-charging pins have no insulating caps on them.
issues.why: Some cars left the factory without the small insulating caps on the DC pins, which can let the charge port get damaged.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to fit the caps under bulletin 25-EV-003G. Have the port checked if fast charging fails.

issues.t: Brake lights and one-pedal driving act oddly
issues.sym: One-pedal (i-Pedal) driving feels different from what you expect, someone behind you says your brake lights act oddly when the car slows on its own, or the 12-volt battery runs low after the car sits.
issues.why: Genesis released a vehicle control software update for the 2023 GV60 that changes when the brake lights come on during regenerative braking, how i-Pedal mode works, and how the car keeps the 12-volt battery charged while parked.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to install the update in bulletin 23-01-082G.

issues.t: Steering wheel buttons stop working
issues.sym: The volume, phone or cruise control buttons on the steering wheel work on and off.
issues.why: A software problem in the steering wheel switch system. Genesis released an update.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin 23-01-087G.

issues.t: Genesis Connected Services drop out
issues.sym: The phone app can't reach the car, or remote start, climate and lock features stop working from time to time.
issues.why: Genesis issued a bulletin for intermittent loss of connected car service connectivity.
issues.next: Restart the car and the app first. If it keeps happening, ask the dealer about bulletin 25-01-018G.

issues.t: Car brakes hard on its own
issues.sym: The automatic emergency braking stops the car suddenly when nothing is in the way, such as during a slow turn.
issues.why: An owner reported the forward collision system braking with no object present. There is no GV60 recall for it so far.
issues.next: Hold the wheel firmly and check your mirrors. Report each event to the dealer and to NHTSA, and ask the dealer to check the front radar and camera.

issues.t: Cargo mat coming apart
issues.sym: The layers of the rear cargo mat peel apart.
issues.why: The glue holding the cargo mat together can let go. Genesis issued a bulletin for it.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin 25-BD-006G while under warranty.

issues.t: Liftgate latch cover stuck down
issues.sym: The spring-loaded cover over the rear latch striker stays stuck down instead of popping back up.
issues.why: Small stopper ribs on the rear trim panel can break. Genesis has a bulletin to inspect and replace the trim.
issues.next: Make sure the liftgate still latches fully. Ask the dealer about bulletin 25-01-084G.
